bash -c 'cols=${COLUMNS:-}; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=$(stty size 2>/dev/null </dev/tty | awk '"'"'{print $2}'"'"');; esac; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=120;; esac; export COLUMNS=$(( cols > 4 ? cols - 4 : 1 )); plugin_dir=$(ls -d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/*/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '"'"'{ print $(NF-1) "\t" $(0) }'"'"' | grep -E '"'"'^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+[[:space:]]'"'"' | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n -k4,4n | tail -1 | cut -f2-); tee -p >("$HOME/.cargo/bin/toktrack" quota record-claude >/dev/null 2>&1) | "/synthetic/bin/node" "${plugin_dir}dist/index.js"'
